milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The oak_button is displayed behind glass on the west wall at spawn-relative [3, 1, 4] (the glass block position — the button itself is at [2,1,4] but the player observes it through the glass). The player must navigate near the glass window and face it to confirm they've found/observed the oak_button. Target is set to the glass block since that's what the player looks at from outside.

Uses inventory_has with item='flower_pot' because mining a potted_poppy block drops a flower_pot item and a poppy item separately (NOT a 'potted_poppy' item). Checking for flower_pot in inventory confirms the player successfully broke the potted_poppy block. The flower_pot is not in the starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has with item='oak_button' because the crafted oak_button ends up in the player's inventory. This is safe because the only oak_button in the scene is placed behind a glass block (at spawn-relative [2,1,4] behind glass at [3,1,4]) and cannot be mined by the player. Therefore, the only way to obtain an oak_button item is by crafting it from oak_planks (which come from the oak_logs inside the structure). The crafting recipe is: 1 oak_plank → 1 oak_button.
